task_description: Refactor all user dashboards (Student, Instructor, Faculty) to deslopify them (eliminate purple gradients, unanchored floating pills, excessive blur, arbitrary dropshadows), enforce Linear/Stripe/Vercel-grade design tokens, balanced 12-column layouts, font-mono tabular-nums, and evenly distributed space.

changes_made.summary: Deslopified Student Dashboard and Phase 0 Onboarding. Upgraded top 3 KPI cards with equal heights and font-mono tabular-nums. Split cockpit into balanced 12-column grid (7 cols for Team Highlights & Important Info, 5 cols for Project Status & Calendar; 7 cols for Submission History, 5 cols for Activity Trail) with matched scrollable heights.
Equalized KPI metrics into a balanced 4-column primary performance row and 3-column project volume breakdown using design system tokens and tabular numbers.

Transformed header into a Linear-grade command bar with academic year badge and live advisory status pill. Structured workload workspace into a 12-column grid (7 cols for Adviser Workload Heatmap, 5 cols for Optimization Engine).
Polished heatmap table with subtle surface borders, tabular numbers, and equalized column headers.
Deslopified optimization suggestions panel with token borders and balanced action button layout.
Refactored Faculty Overview across Adviser, Panelist, and Secretary views with balanced 4-column metric grids, 12-column workspace splits, and deslopified FR4 institutional lock banner.
Configured globalThis.pdfjsLib and window.pdfjsLib to prevent AbortException destructuring crashes in Vite production builds.
Imported pdfWorker on application bootstrap to guarantee pdfjs-dist availability across all lazy-loaded route chunks.

verification_evidence.playwright_visual_audit: Captured 13 multi-viewport screenshots across Student, Instructor, and Faculty dashboards (Light & Dark modes, Desktop 1440x900 & Mobile 390x844) with zero errors and flawless layout balance.
verification_evidence.unit_tests: 8/8 dashboard tests passed (FacultyDashboard.test.jsx: 5 passed, StudentDashboard.test.jsx: 3 passed).
verification_evidence.build_check: Vite production build passed cleanly in 5.18s.
verification_evidence.governance_pipeline: validate:governance passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
